purpose: State exactly which Ross Cameron-derived strategy and discretion components are implemented, partial, unrun, data-blocked, or missing before additional strategy or Level 2 work.

status_definitions.implemented_frozen: Deterministic implementation and a frozen reproducible runtime exist; this does not imply behavioral or economic validity.
status_definitions.implemented_unrun: Code or a registered contract exists, but the genuinely prospective runtime required for interpretation has not run.
status_definitions.partial_deterministic: Some machine rules exist, but material evidence, data, or realism needed for the full behavior is absent.
status_definitions.partial_shadow: Evidence or a descriptive shadow exists without production selection, order, or risk authority.
status_definitions.data_blocked: The component is evidenced but cannot be honestly implemented with the currently frozen data.
status_definitions.missing: No adequate versioned implementation or complete evidence inventory exists.
status_definitions.research_guard: A fail-closed integrity boundary is implemented and is not a trading signal.

decision: Use this matrix as an anti-overclaim and routing artifact. It changes no strategy. Close the Level 2/tape feasibility gate before implementing depth-dependent rules, and promote additional setup families one evidence-backed experiment at a time.
